Same binary, plugin, declarations and source. All observations retained; objective host-load limit 16, RSS 4 GiB, timeout 90 s.

representative_median_run.scope: One actual median observation, not a sum of phase medians.

parallelism_contract: Source parsing and independent overlay copies use up to eight available workers and honor TY_MAX_PARALLELISM. Installation and error propagation retain input order. Parsing regression compares 1, 2, 4, 8 and 256 requested workers with the old sequential loader, including duplicate modules, incomplete syntax, inheritance and the first error. A channel-based regression confirms real overlap and ordered results.

equivalence.scope: CPython semantic equivalence over captured source summaries, not Monty/end-to-end or a comparative latency benchmark.
